name: desktop-notification
description: Alert you when Claude Code needs input: an audible terminal bell, an OSC 9 terminal notification, and an OS-native toast (macOS/Linux) on permission and idle prompts.

desktop_notification_enabled.title: Notification hook
desktop_notification_enabled.description: Runs the whole notification hook. On by default; off mutes every channel below.

desktop_notification_bell_enabled.title: Bell channel
desktop_notification_bell_enabled.description: Audible terminal bell (a bare BEL). On by default.

desktop_notification_terminal_notify_ena.title: Terminal-notify channel (OSC 9)
desktop_notification_terminal_notify_ena.description: OSC 9 terminal notification emitted through the hook's terminalSequence output. On by default.

desktop_notification_os_toast_enabled.title: OS-toast channel
desktop_notification_os_toast_enabled.description: OS-native desktop toast: macOS (osascript) or Linux (requires notify-send). On by default. No effect on Windows, where the terminal channels carry the alert.
